description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参阅[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique across requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence.

A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a token on your client to make sure that the token is unique across different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口删除虚拟节点前，请确保该节点下已经没有ECI实例。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, make sure that no Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances exist on the node.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci delete-virtual-node --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --virtual-node-id vnd-2ze960zkdqrldeaw0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
